messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: gpu-pool-eu1 saturation > 95% (queue growth). Paging oncall@maria :rotating_light:

maria: seeing it, joining. queue length up ~2.1k, tail latency spike on hosted API.

raj: I'm seeing autoscaler failing to spin new instances in eu1, provider API returning 403 quota_exceeded for g4dn-type. logs show ScaleUpHandler error: "quota exceeded".

jin: confirmed. provider quota for GPU instances capped at 48 for the account in eu1. current desired would push to 62. autoscaler didn't fall back to smaller instance types because of pool config.

sophie: customer-facing impact? any errors surfaced to users?

maria: some customers getting 5xx/429s on generation requests. Non-critical tenants queued, but a few PLG customers reported timeouts. cust-success, do you have names?

cust-success: early list: tenant-alpha, tenant-kite experienced elevated errors between 09:12-09:29 UTC. We have a few incoming support tickets.

ops-bot: Deployments: autoscaler v1.3.7 currently active in eu1. Last deploy 6201228000. Rolling back candidate -> not yet.

leo: short-term mitigation idea: enable per-tenant rate limiting to shed best-effort traffic and prioritize reserved/dedicated customers. Can we flip throttle rule on API gateway?

amy: I can flip throttles for non-SLA tenants now. command: `POST /admin/quotas/override {"policy":"egress-shape","scope":"non-sla","rate":10}`. Will apply in ~15s.

maria: do it. mark in timeline.

amy: done. non-sla traffic reduced ~68% immediately, queue growth slowed but still >1k. tail latency improving.

raj: we still need capacity. two parallel options: (A) request provider quota bump (slow), (B) fallback to smaller instance family and update pool config to allow mixed instance types. Option B needs a quick autoscaler config patch and restart.

jin: I can patch autoscaler to allow mixed-instance fallback: change pool config `prefer_exact_instance: true` -> `prefer_exact_instance: false` and add fallback_type: p3-small. Quick patch + rolling restart of autoscaler in eu1.

maria: do it, but be careful — we need canary first. raj, coordinate.

raj: starting canary rollout to 1 replica. `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/autoscaler autoscaler=ghcr.io/redwood/autoscaler:v1.3.8-canary`

ops-bot: Canary observed: scale-up attempts succeeded against p3-small, instances launched in 45s, new capacity accounted. No errors.

leo: nice. canary holds stable. Proceed to full roll.

raj: rolling update to all autoscaler replicas. ETA ~2m.

maria: meanwhile, let's route critical customers to eu2 or to dedicated capacity where possible. product-sr, can we start routing?

product-sr: yes — enabled failover routing for tenant-alpha and tenant-kite to eu2-dedicated. They should see <100ms additional latency but no 5xxs.

cust-success: notified tenants about mitigation and expected degraded experience briefly.

jin: autoscaler v1.3.8 rollout done. pool accepts mixed instance types now. within 3m we recovered ~28 GPUs (smaller family) and queue drained to ~180. tail latency normalized.

maria: timeline note: 09:10 initial alert, 09:16 confirmed quota_exceeded, 09:18 throttles applied, 09:22 canary patch, 09:25 full rollout, 09:28 failover routing complete, 09:31 queue mostly drained.

amy: tickets: 4 open, 2 escalated. I'll post follow-up replies with context.

raj: root causes preliminary: (1) provider quota still at default low value for eu1; (2) autoscaler strict matching logic disallowed mixed-family fallback; (3) eviction logic bug -> when pool partially saturated, the eviction controller attempted to evict running non-preemptible workloads which caused transient slot loss and further constrained scale-up.

jin: dug into eviction logs: eviction-controller attempted to evict 12 tasks with annotation `cache=false` but due to race condition they stayed PENDING and held ephemeral resources. Patch ready: add atomic eviction lease + backoff to prevent double-evictions. I'll open PR now.

maria: good. we should also open provider quota request — ops, please file immediately.

leo: filing request to provider support with case ref RU-6201. Requesting increase to 120 GPUs in eu1 and quota per-region. Including incident logs.

ops-bot: Support case opened: RU-6201. Estimated response 24-72h.

product-sr: action item: for critical tenants, enable automatic region failover for future events. We need runbook update.

maria: assign action items and P0/P1 list.

maria: ACTIONS (initial):
- raj: new autoscaler config default to allow mixed-instance fallback + rollout verification. (in progress)
- jin: PR for eviction controller fix; include unit tests for lease/backoff. (in progress)
- leo: raise provider quota with support + track. (done)
- amy: finish customer comms and ticket updates. (in progress)
- product-sr: update failover runbook and enable automatic failover opt-in for reserved customers. (todo)
- infra: add monitoring alert for `autoscaler.scale_errors.quota_exceeded` and set runbook links. (todo)

raj: note: we should also add autoscaler telemetry to include attempted instance family and failure reason in metrics to make root cause detection faster. I'll add a metric: `autoscaler.scale_fail_reason{reason,region}`.

maria: +1. include as part of postmortem.

jin: opened PR 4832 for eviction fix. Linked to this thread. CI running.

amy: customer comms posted to tenant-alpha and tenant-kite. both acknowledged.

cust-success: tenants asked for SLA credits — routing to billing.

maria: postmortem owners: raj + jin + leo. Draft due EOD tomorrow. Include timeline, impact, metrics, and follow-ups.

ops-bot: Incident severity: SEV2 -> escalate to SEV1 if quota request denied or queue growth resumes.

maria: let's keep monitoring for 2 hours. If queue growth > 500 again, we re-open pager.

leo: quick note on long-term: consider per-region capacity guardrails and quota-aware autoscaler decisions. Also document preferred fallback instance families per region so we avoid manual patches.

jin: agreed. adding to postmortem backlog.

raj: anything else?

product-sr: capture customer impact numbers for finance/billing: total affected requests ~18k, failed ~1.2k, affected tenants 13, duration peak 18 minutes.

maria: good. I'll convert this thread into a postmortem draft and include action items. Thanks all for the quick turnaround. :tada:

lein: reaction :thumbsup: (not a real person, just emoji)

incident-bot: Incident closed (mitigated) at 09:40 UTC. Postmortem draft assigned to raj.

maria: closing thread but keeping watchers.
